entities.name: Thran Empire
entities.description: Ancient, technologically advanced empire that ruled much of Terisiare on Dominaria.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: Continent of Dominaria ruled by the Thran Empire.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which the Thran Empire arose.

entities.name: Halcyon
entities.description: City that became the Thran capital and was levitated by powerstone technology.

entities.name: Thran Civil War
entities.description: Politicized conflict within the Thran elite that ended in the exile of Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Healer-turned-political agitator exiled by the Thran, later recalled to heal Glacian, who founded Phyrexia.

entities.name: Glacian
entities.description: Great Thran artificer whom Yawgmoth was brought back from exile to heal.

entities.name: Thran-Phyrexian War
entities.description: War that ended the Thran era with the collapse of Halcyon and annihilation of the Empire.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Realm Yawgmoth established dominion over after the war.

entities.name: powerstones
entities.description: Technology the Thran used on a massive scale to fuel their civilization.

events.summary: The Thran Civil War consolidates Halcyon's position as capital and ends with the exile of Yawgmoth.
events.quote: culminated in the exile of Yawgmoth

events.summary: Yawgmoth is brought back from exile to heal the artificer Glacian, and the Thran-Phyrexian War begins over diverging visions.
events.quote: brought back from exile to heal the great artificer Glacian

events.summary: The war ends in the collapse of Halcyon, the annihilation of the Thran Empire and the dispersal of its people.
events.quote: The war culminated in the collapse of Halcyon, the annihilation of the Thran Empire, and the dispersal of its people.

events.summary: Yawgmoth establishes dominion over a new realm that becomes the foundation of Phyrexia and is finally banished from Dominaria.
events.quote: Yawgmoth established dominion over a new realm that became the foundation of Phyrexia

relations.quote: The city of Halcyon eventually rose to prominence as the Empire's capital

relations.note: his vision diverged from the ruling elite
relations.quote: Yawgmoth's vision of progress diverged sharply from that of the ruling elite.
